name: Runtime
why: A thread's runtime, from the files and settings it starts with to its scheduled runs and token spread
ideal: A thread starts with every file, host and setting it needs, scheduled runs end clean and no thread spends most tokens.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
Claude Code Docs: Automate work with scheduled tasks
Claude Code Docs: Manage costs effectively

steps.name: Setup
steps.rule: Every file a cloud thread needs is in the repo.

steps.name: Environment
steps.rule: The environment holds every host and variable the project needs.

steps.name: Settings
steps.rule: Every project setting matches the plan.

steps.name: Run
steps.rule: The latest run of every scheduled task ends without an error.

steps.name: Fresh
steps.rule: Some scheduled task has run within the week.

steps.name: Spend
steps.rule: No single thread spends most of the project's tokens.
